verdict.rationale: Goodwin has a dedicated Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice page describing a long-standing, top-ranked practice whose specialists include former federal prosecutors. That suggests enforcement and regulator-facing capability, but the cited excerpt never mentions incident response, breach notification or regulator engagement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of security-incident and breach-response services, evidence of regulator-facing breach work (notifications, investigations, enforcement defense), and a dedicated incident-response page or independent corroboration.
